title: Mandaadi Nears ₹100 Crore as Day-23 Run Keeps Soori Film on Hit Track
excerpt: Soori's Tamil sports drama collected 1.38 crore on its fourth Friday to reach 96.95 crore net in India, with the 100-crore mark expected over the fourth weekend.
body:
• Soori's Tamil sports drama Mandaadi collected 1.38 crore net on its fourth Friday (day 23), taking its India net total to 96.95 crore — just over 3 crore short of the 100-crore mark.
  • The day-23 collection came from 650 shows at 45 percent occupancy, boosted by the Gandhi Jayanti national holiday, even as the film's show count was cut by roughly half.
  • Week-wise, the film earned 57.3 crore in week one, 26 crore in week two and 12.27 crore in week three, with 114.4 crore India gross, 17.7 crore overseas and 132.1 crore worldwide.
  • Made on a reported 50-crore budget, the film is expected to cross 100 crore net over the fourth weekend and earn a hit verdict.

Soori's Mandaadi refuses to slow down. The Tamil sports drama collected 1.38 crore net on its fourth Friday — day 23 of its theatrical run — taking its India net total to 96.95 crore and leaving it just over 3 crore short of the 100-crore mark.

The Friday numbers are the more impressive for coming against a sharply reduced show count. With screens slashed by roughly half to 650 shows, the film posted 45 percent occupancy on the back of the Gandhi Jayanti national holiday, collecting the equivalent of 114.4 crore India gross alongside 17.7 crore overseas for a 132.1-crore worldwide total.

Context & Background

The week-wise trajectory shows a film that has settled into a long, leggy run rather than burning out. Mandaadi opened to 57.3 crore in its first week, followed by 26 crore in week two and 12.27 crore in week three, before the 1.38-crore fourth Friday. Independent trade trackers broadly align on the trend: Newslocker corroborates the 1.38-crore day and 96.95-crore total, while TrackTollywood's chain-tracked gross shows a 23.2 percent day-on-day jump on day 23.

Directed by Mathimaran Pugazhendhi and produced by Elred Kumar under RS Infotainment, the film stars Soori alongside Suhas, Mahima Nambiar and Sathyaraj. Released on September 10 and distributed by Red Giant Movies, it carries a 9.4-out-of-10 rating on BookMyShow. In its fourth week it is reportedly performing better than Soori's newer release, Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai — an unusual reversal where the older title outruns the newer one.

Impact & Analysis

Made on a reported 50-crore budget, Mandaadi needs only a little over 3 crore more to cross 100 crore net in India. By Koimoi's parameters — a film that earns 100 percent profit on India net collections is labelled a hit — crossing the mark over the fourth weekend would secure the hit verdict outright.

The fourth-Friday occupancy figure matters more than the raw crore number. At 45 percent on a reduced screen count, the film is holding its audience rather than merely burning off screens, which is why trade expectations point to a fourth-weekend push past 100 crore rather than a slow fade.

Diaspora Angle

With 17.7 crore in overseas gross, the film has travelled with the Tamil diaspora in Malaysia, Singapore and the Gulf, where mid-budget sports dramas with strong word of mouth tend to find their most loyal audiences.

What's Next

The fourth weekend is the milestone weekend. If Mandaadi crosses 100 crore net as expected, it joins the small club of 2026 Tamil releases to earn a hit verdict on a 50-crore budget — a 2x return that few big-budget titles manage.
